description: This file defines the IUserService interface in the NotesAppBackend.Services namespace, specifying user management operations such as registration, login, and retrieval by ID.

classes.name: IUserService
classes.description: Interface for user-related services including registration, login, and fetching user by ID.

methods.name: RegisterAsync
methods.description: Registers a new user and throws InvalidOperationException if the username or email already exists.

methods.name: LoginAsync
methods.description: Validates user credentials and returns a JWT token response.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the user associated with the specified GUID.
